Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent burns only once. Registration demands a proof of work of 20 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the onyx. That is 27 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
